competition.title: Equity Research Challenge
competition.details:
The Finance Club, IIM Kashipur, brings you the Equity Research Challenge (ERC), the sixth edition of a research-based competition that involves the analysis of a set of companies in a particular sector. In two consecutive online rounds, the competition will test your financial acumen, analytical skills, and business knowledge. 

Eligibility:

  • The competition is open to all full-time students of any undergraduate degree or post-graduation courses, pan-India.
  • Team Size should be 1-3 members, and all the team members should be from the same organisation.
  • Entry to this competition is free.

Round 1 - The Finance Quiz:

  • This will be an eliminatory quiz round, consisting of questions to test the knowledge of the basics of Finance.
  • The quiz can only be attempted by the group leader.
  • The quiz duration will be 30 minutes.
  • The window will be open for 38 hours, between 10:00 AM on 17th October 2026 and 11:59 PM on 18th October 2026, during which the students can attempt the quiz at any time.
  • There won’t be any negative marking for wrong answers.
  • The quiz round will be an eliminatory round, and hence only the selected teams will get the chance to submit their report for the next round.

Round 2 - Online Report Submission Round:

  • The qualifying teams would be required to submit a detailed equity research report after analysing the sector of their choice.
  • Based on the Sector, the teams can choose any Large-cap or Mid-cap company they want to go ahead with, and after accomplishing the analysis, they would be required to submit the equity research report on that particular company.
  • You can refer to the equity research report essentials provided by the CFA Institute (here) to get insights on how to ace an equity research report.

Evaluation:

  • Based on the quality of the submitted reports, the participating teams will be judged by the panellists on various parameters.
  • The decision by the Panel would be final and binding on all the participants.
  • Plagiarism or violation of any of the above-stated rules will lead to the disqualification of the respective team.

organisation.name: Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Kashipur
organisation.description:
• The Indian Institute of Management Kashipur has completed its 10 years as part of the elite league of IIMs. 
  • IIM Kashipur was ranked 33 in India by the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) in 2020.
  • It operates from a fully functional permanent campus of 200 acres.
  • It is located in one of the most densely industrialized regions in the country with over 180 industries having plants in and around the region and many more coming up.
  • IIM Kashipur has been ranked 4th in the D2C Competitive B-Schools 2020. 
  • CFA affiliation has been granted to IIM Kashipur's flagship MBA Program by the CFA Institute.
